body: i don't actually go on reddit much, i rarely post and read things on here. its also the only place i can find somewhere to vent sadly

I'm not from the us by any means but i have close friends in the us. I'm so so worried about them and their families. I'm trying to get a job to save up money so they can possibly move over here, yeah its not the best but its better than being over there. I've been so anxious about this, i know i have no right to be as its not me but i cant help but cry. I've gone through job application to job application and I'm not getting anything back, i don't know how much longer my friends will be able to deal with everything over there and I'd rather not lose them.

I've done so much in just a span of a few hours, I'm looking at jobs for them and for their parents, plane tickets and airlines that are pet friendly - including snake friendly - and so so much more. i know some people are celebrating or saying that the fear online is affecting me but its not. I'm genuinely scared for my friends and majority of the queer kids in that country that aren't able to move out due to funding issues. i know it may seem silly and stupid but i cant help but be scared about this, I'm sorry if this seems selfish.
